answer: One concrete defense is cost-bearing identity binding: each agent must lock a refundable stake and pass a unique hardware-attested enrollment before joining the economy. A sybil operator spawning a thousand fake agents needs a thousand funded stakes and a thousand distinct attestations, so attack cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest users pay once. Picture an ocean of agents where every legitimate worker anchors to a verified reef; unbacked fakes cannot anchor, so their influence never builds a ripple in reputation or payouts.
